data.desc: NetEase Cloud Music (' Cloud Music Inc., ' HKEX: 9899) is one of the leading online music platforms in China with over 200 million monthly active users, featuring an interactive content community for music enthusiasts in terms of user scale and engagement. NCM is also the leading original music platform in China, hosting more than 1.25 million independent musicians. NCM has built a large-scale, robust and rapidly growing business to provide community-centric online music services to its users. NCM empowers music enthusiasts with a wide variety of technology-driven tools to discover, enjoy, share and create diverse music and music-inspired content and to interact with each other.
